uploadErrorCheatsheet.name: PrintableTools Lab Upload Error Cheatsheet Mirror
uploadErrorCheatsheet.purpose: GitHub Pages discovery mirror for common PDF, image, JPG, PNG, resume, and email attachment upload errors with direct free no-signup fixes.

entries.errorText: PDF must be under 1MB
entries.problem: A job, school, email, or admin portal rejects a PDF by file size.
entries.response: Open the PDF compressor with the 1MB target, compress locally, then review readability before submitting.

entries.errorText: PDF must be under 500KB
entries.problem: A strict form, exam upload, or school portal requires a very small PDF.
entries.response: Use the strict 500KB PDF target and keep the original file in case the compressed copy loses detail.

entries.errorText: Image must be less than 2MB
entries.problem: A profile, marketplace, support, or application page rejects an image over 2MB.
entries.response: Use the image-to-KB compressor with a 2048KB custom target.

entries.errorText: Image must be under 500KB
entries.problem: A portal or ticket form requires an image below 500KB.
entries.response: Use the 500KB image target, then resize if a large phone photo still misses the limit.

entries.errorText: Photo must be under 100KB
entries.problem: A job, profile, school, or ID-style form rejects a photo by KB size.
entries.response: Use the 100KB image target and check that the face or document text remains clear.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 200 x 230 px and under 20KB
entries.problem: An exam, job, or application portal combines exact photo dimensions with a very small file cap.
entries.response: Resize to 200 x 230 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 20KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 200 x 230 px and under 50KB
entries.problem: A photo upload box validates both exact 200 x 230 pixel dimensions and a small KB limit.
entries.response: Resize to 200 x 230 pixels first, then compress toward 50KB if the resized output is still too large.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 200 x 230 px and under 100KB
entries.problem: A profile, exam, or application form requires 200 x 230 pixels with a 100KB cap.
entries.response: Create the exact 200 x 230 image, then use the 100KB image target only if needed.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 240 x 320 px and under 50KB
entries.problem: A portrait photo upload requires exact 240 x 320 pixels and rejects files above 50KB.
entries.response: Resize to 240 x 320 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 50KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 295 x 413 px and under 35KB
entries.problem: A portrait photo upload requires exact 295 x 413 pixels and rejects files above 35KB.
entries.response: Resize to 295 x 413 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 35KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 413 x 531 px and under 100KB
entries.problem: An ID-style or application photo upload requires 413 x 531 pixels and rejects files above 100KB.
entries.response: Resize to 413 x 531 pixels, then compress the exported photo toward 100KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 413 x 531 px and under 50KB
entries.problem: A stricter ID-style photo upload requires 413 x 531 pixels and a 50KB cap.
entries.response: Resize to 413 x 531 pixels first, then use the 50KB image target only if the portal requires it.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 354 x 472 px and under 100KB
entries.problem: An ID-style or application photo upload requires exact 354 x 472 pixels and rejects files above 100KB.
entries.response: Resize to 354 x 472 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 100KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 300 x 300 px and under 100KB
entries.problem: A square profile, school, or application photo must be exactly 300 x 300 pixels and below 100KB.
entries.response: Crop to a 300 x 300 square first, then compress toward 100KB if the output is still too large.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 600 x 600 px and under 100KB
entries.problem: A larger square profile, marketplace, or application photo must be 600 x 600 pixels with a 100KB cap.
entries.response: Resize or crop to 600 x 600 pixels, then compress toward 100KB if needed.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 480 x 640 px and under 200KB
entries.problem: A portrait profile or application upload requires 480 x 640 pixels and rejects files above 200KB.
entries.response: Resize to 480 x 640 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 200KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 512 x 512 px and under 100KB
entries.problem: A square avatar, profile, or application photo must be exactly 512 x 512 pixels and below 100KB.
entries.response: Crop or resize to 512 x 512 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 100KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 150 x 200 px and under 20KB
entries.problem: A compact exam or application photo must be 150 x 200 pixels and below 20KB.
entries.response: Resize to 150 x 200 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 20KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 180 x 240 px and under 50KB
entries.problem: A portrait upload box requires exact 180 x 240 pixels and rejects files above 50KB.
entries.response: Resize to 180 x 240 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 50KB if needed.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 400 x 514 px and under 100KB
entries.problem: An ID-style upload requires exact 400 x 514 pixels and a 100KB cap.
entries.response: Resize to 400 x 514 pixels first, then compress toward 100KB only if the export is still too large.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 600 x 800 px and under 200KB
entries.problem: A larger portrait photo upload requires 600 x 800 pixels and rejects files above 200KB.
entries.response: Resize to 600 x 800 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 200KB.

entries.errorText: JPG must be under 200KB

entries.problem: A tiny signature upload box requires exact 100 x 50 pixels and a strict 10KB cap.
entries.response: Resize to 100 x 50 pixels first, then compress the exported signature toward 10KB.

entries.errorText: Signature must be 200 x 60 px and under 20KB
entries.problem: A signature strip requires exact 200 x 60 pixels and a 20KB file limit.
entries.response: Resize to 200 x 60 pixels first, then compress the exported signature toward 20KB if needed.

entries.errorText: Signature must be 256 x 64 px and under 20KB
entries.problem: A signature upload box requires exact 256 x 64 pixels and a strict 20KB cap.
entries.response: Resize to 256 x 64 pixels first, then compress the exported signature toward 20KB.

entries.errorText: Signature must be 400 x 200 px and under 100KB
entries.problem: A larger signature upload box requires exact 400 x 200 pixels and a 100KB file limit.
entries.response: Resize to 400 x 200 pixels first, then compress toward 100KB only if the exported image is still too large.

entries.errorText: PDF not accepted, JPG required
entries.problem: A form accepts images but rejects a PDF upload.
entries.response: Convert PDF pages to JPG/PNG locally and upload the page image the destination expects.

entries.errorText: Resume PDF too large
entries.problem: A job application or recruiter portal rejects a resume PDF by size.
entries.response: Try the 1MB PDF target and confirm all resume text remains readable before applying.

entries.errorText: Email attachment too large
entries.problem: Gmail, Outlook, school email, or work mail rejects a document attachment.
entries.response: Compress PDFs toward 5MB or use the image-to-KB tool for photo attachments.
